Track Length.reason: 3,337 m (official lap length) / 1,609.344 = 2.074 miles; the game stores miles (CircuitManager.cs:46). The traced centreline measures 3323 m.

Safety Car Flag Chance.reason: Default 0.4 (Phoenix is 0.50): not researched for Monte Carlo. Override in the pack config ("datarow") or the manifest.

Virtual Safety Car Chance.reason: Default 0.3 (Phoenix is 0.00): not researched for Monte Carlo. Override in the pack config ("datarow") or the manifest.

Track Rubber Modifier.reason: Neutral 1.0, same as Phoenix. Nothing in the open data says whether rubber goes down faster or slower at Monte Carlo than at a typical circuit.

Minimap Rotation.reason: The minimap sprite is generated north-up in pack-local x/z, so no rotation is needed (MinimapWidget.cs:187 adds minimapRotation to the finish-line angle).

Minimap Axis.reason: Axis "x" maps the sprite width to world x and its height to world z (MinimapWidget.SetTrackDimensions, MinimapWidget.cs:161-173); the pack frame is x = east, z = north.

TS.reason: Neutral weight is 4 (Car.cs:327). The longest straight measures 155 m on the traced centreline (the next longest:  m): 4 x 155/900 = 0.7, rounded to 1.

ACC.reason: Neutral 4 = one third of the corners being low-speed. The corner-finder emulator finds 18 corners, 12 of them Low, so traction exits matter about as much as average: 4 x 12/6.0 = 8.0 -> 6.

DEC.reason: Braking weight counts hard stops: corners entered after a straight of at least 250 m. The emulator finds 6; 4 x 6/5 = 4.8 -> 5 (5 such zones taken as neutral).

HSC.reason: The three corner weights share a total of 12 (neutral 4 each) in proportion to corner length by emulated speed class: high-speed corners are 0% of corner length (0 corners): 12 x 0.00 = 0.0 -> 1.

MSC.reason: The three corner weights share a total of 12 (neutral 4 each) in proportion to corner length by emulated speed class: medium-speed corners are 32% of corner length (6 corners): 12 x 0.32 = 3.8 -> 4.

LSC.reason: The three corner weights share a total of 12 (neutral 4 each) in proportion to corner length by emulated speed class: low-speed corners are 68% of corner length (12 corners): 12 x 0.68 = 8.2 -> 6.

First Tyre Option.reason: The softest of the three compounds on offer (default; not researched for Monte Carlo). Same first option as Phoenix.

Second Tyre Option.reason: Middle compound, the usual race-day workhorse.

Third Tyre Option.reason: Hardest compound the game offers (default; not researched for Monte Carlo).

Tyre Wear Rate.reason: Default Medium (Phoenix is Low): not researched for Monte Carlo.

Fuel Burn Rate.reason: A 3.3 km lap with 0% of its length on straights over 250 m is slightly fuel-hungry per lap, but the game scales burn by lap length already; Medium, same as Phoenix.

Travel Cost.reason: Millions, same scale as the Locations table. Default 0.075 (Phoenix, scene-Phoenix.txt CIRCUIT DATA ROW): travel cost for Monte Carlo not researched.
